# MultiTechnologyInspectionFusion

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
An architecture integrating multiple sensing and analysis technologies (e.g., visual, thermal, and acoustic) into a single inspection pipeline for power equipment. Demonstrates how heterogeneous data streams can be fused in-network, a key challenge for TCC/iNEST edge processing.
